name: Do energy-efficient windows qualify for any rebates or tax credits?

mainEntity.name: Do energy-efficient windows qualify for any rebates or tax credits?

acceptedAnswer.text: While federal tax credits for energy-efficient home improvements vary and may be subject to legislative changes, there have been federal incentives in the past for specific products meeting certain energy performance criteria. Additionally, local utility companies or state programs in California sometimes offer rebates for upgrading to energy-efficient windows. We recommend checking current federal and local programs or consulting with a tax professional to understand any available incentives at the time of your purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Federal tax credits and local utility rebates may be available for energy-efficient windows, but eligibility varies and is subject to change. Check current programs.
